rater: Codex assistant, visual inspection; not independent human annotation

observations.camera_only: Selected zoom in/out and rotate/pan effects agree with canonical prefixes.
observations.camera_object: Selected object add/remove and camera edits present. Hardcoded center location removed from all100 labels before training.
